EIA oil inventories: the sharper squeeze is in distillates
Why it matters: The U.S. Energy Information Administration's 4 November 2026 petroleum report puts the clearest sign of fuel-stock tightness in distillates.
Context: For the week ending 30 October, distillate inventories fell 3.6 million barrels and stood 13% below their five-year average.
